tier_compliance.reason: The hint links the visible color bar to the science quantity, 'specific humidity levels,' without using it to select an answer.

visual_grounding.reason: It identifies the central highlighted area and the specific humidity color bar visible below the map.

scientific_correctness.reason: The color bar does indicate specific humidity levels, consistent with the map and reference.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: It directs attention to the relevant area and legend without suggesting an incorrect level.

answer_disclosure.reason: It gives no humidity value, range, color match, or option preference.

actionability.reason: Identifying the outlined area and color bar gives a clear direction, but the student must work out how to compare their colors.
